items.title: Building NICHLYST: Two Mugs, a Black Screen, and the Weekend the Engine Woke Up
items.author: Eugene Kozlovsky
items.summary: A friend came by last Thursday and handed me a mug she had brought from Bulgaria. On the mug was a Kama Sutra position so acrobatic that gravity itself seemed ready to file a complaint. "So that there would be love," she said. It felt strangely appropriate: the thing on my desk that week was a half-asleep HTML5 game engine, and it was going to need exactly that kind of stubborn love to wake up.
